good: Real track with bends, a tunnel, a cliff section, a city skyline and neon gantries; with W only the car runs into the wall, so there is no auto-steer
Speed reads well: 200+ km/h, motion blur on the sides, and the boost bar visibly changes state (orange, then cyan 'boost ready', then 'boosting')
Shift drift shows smoke, skid marks and a 'DRIFT' timer, and the trailer shows a rival wreck with the takedown counter going up
bad: In free play the car flips and crashes on the barrier often; it spends long stretches at 2-40 km/h and stays 8th the whole time
The takedown frame is a yellow glow blob on the rival; no big 'TAKEDOWN!' card is visible in any frame
The world is flat low-poly with plain green fields and blocky buildings, and the HUD text is small and hard to read
opus-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks like a real track with tunnels and cliffs and the boost feels fast, but the walls flip you too easily and the takedowns don't hit hard.

good: Boost visibly widens the view and adds speed blur.
Drifts show sideways slides, smoke and HUD feedback.
Walkthrough shows a rival wreck, tunnel and cliff section.
bad: Repeated wall flips and near-stops interrupt the racing.
Sparse scenery, basic buildings and flat lighting limit immersion.
The takedown counter changes, but no prominent takedown card is readable.
gpt-6.1-sol-xhigh.one_line: The speed and smoky slides look fun, but frequent wall trouble and a sparse world keep it feeling like a prototype.

good: Complete burnout-style HUD: position 1ST/8, lap 1/3, takedowns, boost bar with 'drift to fill boost' prompt, big italic KM/H speed and minimap
Real circuit with genuine bends, a tunnel, a neon-lit bridge, city blocks, cliffs and guardrails; no traffic, only rivals
Walkthrough shows 250 km/h runs, drift smoke/skids, boost fill and one visible wall wreck of a yellow rival (takedowns counter ticks to 1)
bad: Player car is a featureless rounded red blob with no visible wheels or trim, and the world is flat untextured green hills - plain but not sloppy
Takedown is never readable: no 'TAKEDOWN!' card is visible in any frame, just a flash and a counter bump, and no slow-motion is apparent
Scripted drive repeatedly ends with the car beached against barriers at 2-17 KM/H, and one frame shows the car flipped/launched on its side, so the collision physics feel janky
minimax-m3.1-flash-free.one_line: A real playable low-poly racer with a proper Burnout HUD and a nicely varied circuit, but the cars are undetailed blobs and the takedown never delivers a punchy payoff.
